notes.title: A Flawless World of Cats
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35151506/a7d7718447c4ead818892f4f66bd1ff1c2fdb299.png[/img]
Have a read of our [url=https://bareknuckledev.com/games/flawless/flawless-world-of-cats/]latest article[/url] about the world of cats that is the setting for The Flawless: Art's Tale. 

We are currently wrapping up development on Super Mega Space Blaster Special. We aim to be back working full time on The Flawless by December at the latest. We'll have loads more news, screenshots and gossip about the game soon.

Happy gaming 😃

notes.title: The Flawless Discord Channel Now Live - Join Today
notes.content:
We've added a Flawless Discord channel to the BKD Discord: Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/DuXaY2P]https://discord.gg/DuXaY2P[/url]

Join for loads of chat about our metroidvania hack 'n' shoot action-RPG The Flawless: Art's Tale. Get early access to beta test, discuss features you want to see in the game, talk about the characters, if you're interested in the game this is the place to be.

The server also contains channels for our other games including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080330/Super_Mega_Space_Blaster_Special/]Super Mega Space Blaster Special[/url] - the retro inspired frantic space shooter, as well as general channels for retro gaming, indie games, gaming, and general chat.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: The Flawless' Steam Page is up!
notes.content: Willkommen! Bienvenue! Welcome to The Flawless: Art's Tale's Steam page! The game is really taking shape, it's currently in pre-alpha but we should have more to show very soon. If you have any questions or things to discuss about the game here is a great place to do it. Thanks for reading.
